mismatch.message: Replay error: OBJ_BURIED is not defined

summary: The case reaches the carried-boulder burial branch of mon.c:xkilled. JavaScript mirrors the C pit and inventory predicates and passes CORPSTAT_BURIED to make_corpse(), whose bury_an_obj() call buries the corpse. It then evaluates cadaver.where === OBJ_BURIED before printing C's visible buried-corpse message, but js/mon.js did not import OBJ_BURIED. Importing the existing obj.h enum constant preserves the C message guard; the admitted case now matches through all 772 recorded steps.

callers: mon.c:make_corpse -> bury_an_obj when CORPSTAT_BURIED is set
findings: mon.c:xkilled checks mtrapped, finds a pit at the monster coordinates, and sets burycorpse when m_carrying(mtmp, BOULDER) succeeds (lines 3514-3522).
The ordinary corpse path passes CORPSTAT_BURIED to make_corpse when burycorpse is true (lines 3617-3628).
The buried-corpse message is conditional on the returned corpse being OBJ_BURIED and visible, matching the source state transition and message guard.

js/mon.js imports CORPSTAT_BURIED and implements the corresponding make_corpse/bury_an_obj path, but its constants import list omits OBJ_BURIED while xkilled reads it at the message guard. js/const.js already exports OBJ_BURIED as the C obj.h enum value 6.
The admitted evaluation reports ReferenceError 'OBJ_BURIED is not defined'; this is a missing binding, not evidence of different random or burial behavior.
The actual challenge caller is zap.c:dobuzz -> zhitm -> xkilled. Its source-correct xkilled path reaches the carried-boulder pit branch at the recorded burial action.

evidence: Read nethack-c/upstream/src/mon.c:xkilled. The pit guard at lines 3514-3522 sets burycorpse only when the monster is trapped over a pit and carries a boulder; the corpse branch at lines 3617-3628 passes CORPSTAT_BURIED and tests cadaver->where == OBJ_BURIED before its message.

Read js/mon.js:xkilled and make_corpse. JavaScript has the same carried-boulder predicate, awaits make_corpse(CORPSTAT_BURIED), and compares cadaver.where to OBJ_BURIED, but the top-level imports do not bind OBJ_BURIED.
Read js/const.js:1196, which exports OBJ_BURIED = 6, and js/bury.js:bury_an_obj, which is the existing helper used by make_corpse when burythem is true.
The admitted v74 evaluation identifies the stop as ReferenceError 'OBJ_BURIED is not defined'; the source comparison pinpoints the missing js/mon.js import at the message guard.
After importing OBJ_BURIED, scripts/mon-kill.test.mjs forces a visible corpse through the carried-boulder pit path and asserts the buried-corpse message.
scripts/synthetic-range-evidence.mjs replays synthetic/v74/v74-jelly-carrier-burial-action6 segment 0 through step 771; all recorded screens, cursors and RNG values match.

sourceChanges: js/mon.js imports OBJ_BURIED from js/const.js so the xkilled() buried-corpse message guard reads the C object-location enum.
scripts/mon-kill.test.mjs marks the corpse square visible, forces corpse_chance to create a corpse, and asserts the buried-corpse message after settlement.
